messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex V, Part B, point 7

7. An undertaking to transmit, in response to a reasoned request by the national authorities, relevant information on the partly completed machinery. This shall include the method of transmission and shall be without prejudice to the intellectual property rights of the manufacturer of the partly completed machinery.

response.text:
the undertaking | requiresTransmissionOf | relevant information on the partly completed machinery | in response to a reasoned request by the national authorities | An undertaking to transmit, in response to a reasoned request by the national authorities, relevant information on the partly completed machinery.
the undertaking | includes | the method of transmission | | This shall include the method of transmission
